blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses listings went from 86 to 98, and it took 10.7% of the city’s 298 detached houses sales over the period; condos and townhomes listings went from 0 to 2, and it took 0.0% of the city’s 558 condos and townhomes sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Brookswood for detached houses in June, August, September (a buyers’ best bet).
